test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He is as concerned as me / regarding / the renewed / examination schedule.

options.text: He is as concerned as me

solution:
The correct answer is '**He is as concerned as me**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this sentence lies in the comparison being made.
 
• When making comparisons, especially with the verb "**to be**," the subjective pronoun form should be used rather than the objective pronoun form.
 
• This is because both subjects are performing the action of the verb (being concerned in this case).
 
• Therefore, "**me**" should be replaced with "**I**" to correctly construct the comparison, making the correct phrase "**He is as concerned as I**."

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

**Correct Sentence**: ***He is as concerned as I** regarding the renewed examination schedule.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Segments 1) "**the renewed**," 2) "**examination schedule**," and 3) "**regarding**" do not contain grammatical errors. They are correctly used in the context of the sentence.
 
• "**The renewed**" correctly modifies "examination schedule," indicating that the schedule has been updated or changed.
 
• "**Regarding**" is the correct preposition to introduce the topic of concern, which in this case is the examination schedule.
